extras.Usage: Pilot eye transform. Forward: Blender +Y / glTF -Z. Up: Blender +Z / glTF +Y.

FPV_Rig.camera_note: The camera is pitched down 14 degrees. Use the eye marker for a level camera or free look.
FPV_Rig.instruments_note: Map telemetry linearly to the angle range, with modulo for wrap. Use angle about the specified local axis starting from identity, or sample the Dial_ clip at (value-min)/(max-min) seconds.
FPV_Rig.controls_note: Apply rotations to the rest quaternion in local space. The supplied clips are for preview and animation. Input mapping, physics and telemetry run in the game engine.
